rows.question: Is MBA after BTech worth it or should i work first?

**Guidance** (Choosing between a job, MS, MTech or MBA) [S1]: Decide by the role you want in 3-5 years. Research and specialised roles (ML research, VLSI, core engineering design) often value an MS/MTech; management, consulting and product-strategy roles value an MBA, which works best after 2-4 years of work experience. For most software, data and cloud roles, skills and projects matter more than a second degree, so working first and studying later is a common, low-risk path.
